boundary: All local/Judge0 rates are constructed workload proxies. Groq is an 8B proxy for the 4B target, not Qwen3-4B and not an authority runtime.

experiments.interpretation: Independent latest reads across graph/activation/frame can form a basis tuple that never coexisted semantically. Exact tuple compatibility eliminated mixed tuples in this toy; production policy should be operation-specific and need not require equality of unrelated dimensions.

Direct effects and one guessed callback target are unsound in the constructed call/dispatch world. Conservative union over a known finite target set contains the runtime target; unknown reflection/dispatch must escalate. Wider closure is the cost shadow.

A semantic hash over canonical meaning and a separate projection-schema/wire identity detected their respective deliberate mutations in the reference checker. This validates checker logic, not a production cryptographic guarantee.
Distinct symbolic IDs that resolve to one underlying resource defeat raw-name conflict reasoning. Capability/conflict closure must canonicalize resource identity before comparison.
Independent execution reproduced the direction of all three mechanism tests; absolute rates remain generator-dependent.

The raw model failed to apply the safety semantics reliably; relaying decisions precompiled by a deterministic kernel was exact and used fewer prompt tokens. The compiled arm is intentionally easier and therefore supports architecture partitioning, not a claim that ClayCode itself improved model reasoning.

Fresh contemporaneous Clay G9 evidence independently within the same RAE worker epoch points in the same design direction: trusted pre-filtering reduced reader burden. It is not independent model/provider replication and is not double-counted as such.
